record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.context_brief: Local rigidity away from Weyl chamber walls
record.original_question: In the setting where G is a connected semisimple Lie group, Γ is an irreducible lattice in G, A is a closed subgroup of a split Cartan subgroup D of G with dim A > 1, and A is not contained in a wall of a Weyl chamber of D, is every C^1-small perturbation of the action of A on G/Γ C^∞-conjugate to an action of A defined by a continuous homomorphism from A to D?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 2. If in Conjecture 1 the group A is not contained in a wall of a Weyl chamber of the split Cartan subgroup D, then any C 1-small perturbation of the action of A on G /Γ is C ∞ -conjugate to the action of A deﬁned by a continuous homomorphism from A to D.

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $G$ be a connected semisimple Lie group, let $\Gamma \subset G$ be an irreducible lattice, and let $D \subset G$ be a split Cartan subgroup. Let $A \subset D$ be a closed subgroup with $\dim A \ge 2$ which is not contained in any wall of a Weyl chamber of $D$. Consider the action $\alpha_0$ of $A$ on the homogeneous space $G/\Gamma$ by left translations. Prove or disprove the following: every $C^1$-small perturbation $\alpha$ of $\alpha_0$ (in the space of $C^\infty$ actions of $A$ on $G/\Gamma$) is $C^\infty$-conjugate to an action of $A$ on $G/\Gamma$ of the form $a \mapsto L_{\rho(a)}$, where $\rho \colon A \to D$ is a continuous homomorphism and $L_g$ denotes left translation by $g$.
artifact.category_tag: Local rigidity of higher-rank abelian actions
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture (a Katok–Spatzier type local rigidity statement for higher-rank abelian actions away from Weyl chamber walls) has been established in many cases. Damjanović–Katok proved it for $G=\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb{R})$ with $A$ a generic two-plane (or containing a lattice in one) in the split Cartan, and Vinhage–Wang (Geom. Dedicata 2019) gave a substantially complete solution via the geometric method for partially hyperbolic algebraic actions on homogeneous spaces of semisimple Lie groups, covering most cases of the conjecture. The general statement in full generality (all semisimple $G$, all closed $A$ of $\dim\ge 2$ off Weyl chamber walls) is widely regarded as largely resolved but not in a single uniform theorem in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Local rigidity of higher rank homogeneous abelian actions: a complete solution via the geometric method
status_evidence.snippet: Shows local and cocycle rigidity for most abelian higher-rank partially hyperbolic algebraic actions on homogeneous spaces of semisimple Lie groups, including actions that are not restrictions of Weyl chamber flows.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a near-complete resolution of the local rigidity conjecture in the generic (off-walls) higher-rank setting.

status_evidence.title: Local rigidity of restrictions of Weyl chamber flows
status_evidence.snippet: Damjanović–Katok prove local rigidity for $C^2$-small perturbations on $\mathrm{SL}(n,\mathbb{R})/\Gamma$ when $A$ contains a lattice in a two-plane in general position in the maximal split Cartan.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the conjecture in important special cases.

status_evidence.title: Anatole Katok's work on cohomology and geometric rigidity (Spatzier)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing progress on local rigidity of higher-rank abelian actions away from Weyl chamber walls.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms substantial progress with cases still being completed.
